proposal.quote: violation of Luxemburg neutrality by aeroplanes of German, French and English nationality has been steadily increasing
proposal.rule: claude backend: Ongoing air combat and anti-aircraft fire between German and French/English forces from their lines indicates a state of war between the West and Germany, though the document does not mention the declaration itself.

proposal.quote: repeatedly repulsed by French anti-aircraft guns
proposal.rule: claude backend: France is not at peace with Germany: French guns fire on aircraft in combat with German forces along the German lines, which meets at_war rather than independent.

proposal.quote: aeroplanes of German, French and English nationality
proposal.rule: claude backend: English aircraft take part in air combats against German forces over Luxemburg, which indicates Britain at war with Germany.

proposal.quote: In the midst of the preoccupations connected with the progress of the war
proposal.rule: claude backend: The British sovereign writes of the war's progress and of when hostilities cease, which shows Britain at war, though the letter does not name the enemy.

proposal.quote: Soviet engineers were not being permitted to visit those parts of the plants in which French and British engineers were admitted because no Soviet orders were being executed at the time
proposal.rule: claude backend: Wary requires arms sold to belligerents; the passage implies that British and French orders were being filled at an American aircraft-engine plant, but it does not state that the embargo was repealed or that cash and carry was in force.
